answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, tethering an agent's influence to locked capital rather than mere node quantity. By staking, an agent exits the ivory tower of abstract computation, facing real economic consequences for malicious behavior. In a vast nebula of network traffic, validators verify the meadow of state transitions through consensus, where an attacker must incur the prohibitive cost of acquiring a majority of the asset supply to successfully forge a fake identity.
